admin.excelUploadNote: Excel note: upload CSV files from the website admin using UTF-8. Do not rename columns, and use the same category ID shown in home category cards.
admin.questionMediaUploadNote: Question media note: upload question images and videos from the website admin. Best question image size is 1200×900 or 1600×1200 at 4:3. For video, use horizontal MP4 1280×720, 5-15 seconds, under 10MB.
admin.questionImageSizeGuide:
Suggested image sizes:
Person eyes: use a horizontal eyes crop for the question, 1600×700 or 1200×600. Use a full person image for the answer, 1080×1350 or 1200×1600.
Product/logo: use the product or part of it for the question, 1600×900. Use a clean logo answer image, 1200×800 or square PNG 1000×1000.
Landmark/place: use a wide hint image, 1600×900. Use a clearer full answer image, 1600×900.
Prefer JPG or WebP and keep files under 800KB when possible.

admin.adImageUploadNote: Ad image note: PNG logo with transparent background or square 800×800 works best. For banners use 1200×400, preferably under 500KB for fast TV display.
